title: The conjecture that every 5-connected planar triangulation is POSH
statement: A planar triangulation is a planar graph that admits a plane embedding in which every face is a triangle, and a graph is **POSH** (partial one-sided Hamiltonian) if it is a spanning subgraph of a graph admitting a plane embedding with a one-sided Hamiltonian cycle. **5-connected planar triangulation conjecture.** Every 5-connected planar triangulation is POSH. This conjecture concerns the rich class of POSH graphs studied through the exploding double chain; the source relates the expectation to the abundance of Hamiltonian cycles in 5-connected graphs, but gives no resolution.
source_name: Stefan Felsner, Hendrik Schrezenmaier, Felix Schröder and Raphael Steiner, “Linear Size Universal Point Sets for Classes of Planar Graphs”, arXiv:2303.00109 (2023).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.00109

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of March 2023).
